notes:
• Automatic updates: MXG Scout checks for a new version when it starts and every 6 hours. A yellow bar offers "Update now", the download is verified (exact size, SHA-256 checksum and version check), and MXG Scout swaps itself in and restarts with the same files in its list.
• "Check for updates automatically" setting (takes effect immediately). The title bar shows whether you're up to date.
• New Help menu: Release Notes, Check for Updates Now, Keyboard Shortcuts & About. After an update, MXG Scout shows what's new automatically.
• Smaller download: about 39 MB instead of 105 MB.
